about: FICTIONAL DEMO FEEDSTOCK. An invented kraft lignin stream at an invented mill, for demonstrating BioValue AI. Every figure is an illustrative assumption (basis 'fictional_assumption') or calculated from them (basis 'calculated'); none is a measurement from a real mill. Schema: backend/feedstock.py.
name: Pinecrest Mill kraft lignin cake (fictional)
disclaimer: Fictional demo data: the Pinecrest Mill and this lignin stream are invented. All values are illustrative assumptions, not measurements from any real mill, and must be replaced with a mill's own lab data before any decision.
feedstock_type: Washed softwood kraft lignin filter cake from an acid-precipitation unit at a kraft pulp mill (fictional)

annual_wet_quantity.note: Wet filter cake leaving the precipitation unit. The range reflects assumed swings in pulp production.

moisture_pct.note: Filter cake as discharged; there is no dryer at the fictional mill.

dry_matter.note: Calculated from the fictional wet quantity and moisture.

lignin_pct.method: Acid-insoluble (Klason) plus acid-soluble lignin, as % of dry matter (method stated for illustration)

sulfur_pct.method: Total sulfur by elemental analysis (stated for illustration)

carbohydrates_pct.method: Total sugars after acid hydrolysis (stated for illustration)

mw_g_per_mol.note: Not measured at the fictional mill. See data_gaps.

phenolic_oh_mmol_per_g.note: Not measured at the fictional mill. See data_gaps.

sodium_pct.note: Not measured at the fictional mill. See data_gaps.

variability.summary: Fictional: volume and quality are assumed to vary over the year. Each figure's low/high is its assumed range over a year of normal operation.
drivers: Pulp production rate, including planned shutdowns (assumed)
Performance of the precipitation and cake-washing steps (assumed)

current_use.description: Fictional: the precipitated lignin is fired in the mill's own boilers in place of purchased fuel. The unit was built to relieve the recovery boiler, not to sell lignin.

infrastructure.name: Filter presses with cake washing
infrastructure.note: Fictional; part of the precipitation unit.

infrastructure.name: Lignin dryer
infrastructure.note: Fictional. Lignin leaves the mill as wet cake, so any buyer who needs dry powder would need a dryer first.

capacity.note: About two weeks of wet cake at the base rate.

infrastructure.name: Mill steam and power
infrastructure.note: Fictional: spare steam and power are assumed to be available for future processing steps.

geographic_market.logistics: Fictional: rail siding at the mill; the nearest deep-water port is assumed to be about 150 km away.

data_gaps.impact: Every figure in this profile is invented for demonstration. Results based on it say nothing about a real mill.
data_gaps.next_step: Replace the profile with the mill's own lab data and production records.

data_gaps.impact: Molecular weight can't be compared with any pathway requirement until it is measured.
data_gaps.next_step: Commission a lab analysis of molecular weight distribution, and record the method used.

data_gaps.impact: Phenolic hydroxyl content can't be compared with any pathway requirement until it is measured.
data_gaps.next_step: Commission a lab analysis of hydroxyl group content, and record the method used.

data_gaps.impact: The make-up of the ash is unknown, so ash-related requirements can only be checked against total ash.
data_gaps.next_step: Request an inorganic element analysis of the ash.

data_gaps.impact: Reported lignin content depends on what the analysis counts. The method here is stated for illustration only.
data_gaps.next_step: Confirm the analytical method with the lab and use the same one when comparing with buyers' specifications.

data_gaps.impact: Moisture sets the dry tonnage (dry matter = wet quantity x (1 - moisture)) and the mass that has to be shipped.
data_gaps.next_step: Log cake moisture for each shift over at least one month.
